o.text: From Proto-Turkic *ōn (“ten”). Cognate with Old Turkic 𐰆𐰣 (on, “ten”).
Borrowed from Persian بیغیرت (bê-ġeyrat). By surface analysis, bi- (“-less”) + qeyrət (“honor”).
From Ottoman Turkish قورلتای (qurultay), from Middle Mongol ᠬᠤᠷᠢᠯᠲᠠ (qurilta).
Borrowed from Classical Persian بى آبرو. By surface analysis, bi- + abır.
